messages:
joel: Heads-up: a customer reported install flakiness when we publish wheels + sdist. On mac arm, pip picks sdist because the only wheel on PyPI was manylinux x86_64. Builds in their image took forever.

fiona: Do we have a reproducible minimal repro? Which release/version?

joel: Repro: macOS 12 arm64 runner, py3.11 venv -> `pip install redwood-sdk==1.3.0` -> pip says wheel not supported and builds sdist (PEP 517) which requires build deps and slows down. Also mypy flags "package is not typed".

build-bot: CI note: the release workflow used `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` only for bdist_wheel. The macos matrix step was accidentally omitted in the release job templating.

qa: Workarounds for customers: `pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk@main` (we have arm wheels on main) or `pip install --no-build-isolation redwood-sdk==1.3.0` if build deps are already present. Not great for onboarding.

sam: Action plan: (1) include `redwood_sdk/py.typed` in the package/manifest so type checkers work, (2) fix GH Actions to produce universal2 mac wheels (macos-12/13) and manylinux, (3) add a release smoke test that runs `pip install redwood-sdk==${{ release }}` on mac arm runner and on a minimal linux builder.

fiona: I'll push a small packaging patch to add `py.typed` and update MANIFEST.in. Also adding `setuptools>=65` to build-system.requires in pyproject to avoid old wheel behavior.

joel: Great. Please also add a short doc in /docs/packaging.md about poetry vs pip editable installs and how to generate a constraints file for image builds: `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes > constraints.txt` then `pip install -r constraints.txt --no-deps` to get deterministic transitive deps.

build-bot: Created GH issue #2511: "packaging: publish mac/universal2 wheels; include py.typed; add release install smoke tests" -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/issues/2511

qa: I'll re-run the image tests once 1.3.1 wheels are published and confirm the build time drop.

joel: Thanks team — assigning to fiona for the packaging PR and to sam for CI changes. :thumbsup:
